scenes.title: the dark street and the first lamp
scenes.place: a village street at night, a low doorway, tiled roofs, marigold garlands
scenes.summary: A hand lights one diya on a threshold; a child carries the flame down the street and the neighbours answer.

visual.subject: one clay diya, a warm doorway, a child, a row of lamps
visual.setting: indigo night, cream walls, clay-tile roofs, a temple silhouette, marigold
visual.action: the match touches the wick; the child lifts the diya and walks; lamps light behind her

scenes.title: the river and the goddess
scenes.place: a wide river at night, ghats, a giant lotus, a low moon
scenes.summary: The lotus opens on the water and Lakshmi rises with four arms, gold sari, crown, lotuses in her upper hands.

visual.subject: Lakshmi rising from a lotus, four arms, crown, gold sari
visual.setting: dark teal water, ripples, reflections, distant ghats and a temple, moon and fireflies
visual.action: petals open, the water rings out, she rises until she stands on the flower and raises the upper hands

scenes.title: the home, the rangoli, the offering
scenes.place: a warm courtyard with a real eight-fold rangoli, then a brass puja thali
scenes.summary: Hands draw the rangoli around a lamp; the same hands set a flower on the thali and the flame leans out.

visual.subject: rangoli, powder bowls, marigold, a brass thali, a lit diya, offering hands
visual.setting: ochre wall, wooden door, hanging lamp, garland, warm night courtyard
visual.action: the hands pull the rangoli lines outward; the pattern blooms; a flower is offered and the flame leans toward the lens
